blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Loren Legarda extended anew her medical leave to October 9, Senate Secretary Renato Bantug said on Monday. In a message sent to the Inquirer, Bantug said Legarda filed a medical leave anew from Sept. 21 to 23, Sept. 28 to Oct 2, and Oct. 5 to 9. This is the sixth time that Legarda filed her medical leave amid reports that she is in France and seeking treatment for a lung ailment, as claimed by some colleagues.
